/** @jest-environment jsdom */
/**
 * PREPARED, UNRUN. Place beside the real native thunk tests only after the
 * native owner releases the existing execution hold and installs the packed SDK.
 * This file imports native owners unchanged. It is deliberately not an SDK test.
 * See docs/native-portal-differential.md for provenance and known failing cases.
 */
import axios from 'axios';
import { act, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import { createNativePortalCollectionKernel } from '@miniextensions/sdk/portals';
import type {
    AirtableField,
    AirtableRecord,
} from '@type-system/airtable/types';
import type { LinkedRecordDetailField } from '@type-system/airtable/linked-record-detail-fields-types';
import type { FetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortalOutput } from '@type-system/api/types/fetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortal';
import { ExtensionScreen } from '@type-system/api/types/loadExtension';
import { ExtensionType } from '@type-system/constants/extensionType';
import {
    currentExtensionsVersionIndex,
    type SharableExtension,
} from '@type-system/generated/extension-versions/current/extension';
import { getPublicFieldsFromExtension } from '@type-system/generated/extension-versions/current/PublicFields';
import {
    test_generateLinkedRecordsField,
    test_generateSingleLineTextField,
} from '@type-system/helpers/testFieldsGenerators';
import { DEFAULT_THEME_COLOR } from '@type-system/helpers/getThemeStyles';
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE } from '@type-system/i18n/strings';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast';
import { createNativePortalPresentation } from '../../Portal/createNativePortalPresentation';
import publicExtensionReducer, {
    publicExtensionActions,
} from '../publicExtensionReducer';
import { portalPresentationBinding } from '../acceptedPortalFrame';
import { fetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortalThunk } from '../thunks/fetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortalThunk';
import type { ScreenState } from '../types';
import {
    createInitialPublicExtensionState,
    createTestStore,
} from './publicExtensionSelectors.test-helpers';
import { makeFieldIdsToSchemas } from './makeFieldIdsToSchemas';

// Only the external HTTP boundary is doubled. Reducer, thunk, selectors,
// response-frame constructor, presentation, and toast implementation are real.
jest.mock('axios');
const http = axios as jest.MockedFunction<typeof axios>;
const sessionId = 'sess_collection';
const fieldId = 'fld00000000000001';
const tableId = 'tbl00000000000001';
const primary = test_generateSingleLineTextField({
    fieldId: 'fld00000000000002',
    fieldName: 'Title',
    isPrimaryField: true,
});
const linked = test_generateLinkedRecordsField({
    fieldId,
    fieldName: 'Projects',
    options: {
        linkedTableId: tableId,
        isReversed: false,
        prefersSingleRecordLink: false,
    },
});
const detail: LinkedRecordDetailField = {
    fieldId: primary.id,
    fieldName: primary.name,
    titleOverride: '',
    isHidden: true,
    miniExtConfig: {},
    fieldIsInEditingChildForm: false,
    childFormField: null,
};
type PortalScreen = Extract<
    ScreenState,
    { extensionScreen: ExtensionScreen.PORTAL_LOADED }
>;
type Response = FetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortalOutput;

function screenFixture(token = 'token_A'): PortalScreen {
    const extension: SharableExtension = {
        id: 'ext_collection',
        shareId: 'shr_collection',
        description: null,
        updatedTime: 1700000000000,
        createdTime: 1700000000000,
        lastEditorUID: 'usr_collection',
        version: currentExtensionsVersionIndex,
        baseId: 'app_collection',
        name: 'Collection fixture',
        type: ExtensionType.PORTAL,
        userUID: 'usr_collection',
        state: { tableId },
    };
    const publicFields = getPublicFieldsFromExtension({ extension });
    if (publicFields.type !== ExtensionType.PORTAL)
        throw new Error('Invalid Portal fixture');
    const fieldNamesToSchemas = {
        Projects: {
            airtableField: structuredClone(linked),
            fieldType: linked.config.type,
            miniExtConfig: {
                allowEditingRecords: true,
                extensionIdForEditing: 'ext_collection_child',
            },
        },
    };
    return {
        extensionId: extension.id,
        language: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
        enableCommentsOnChildForms: false,
        googleAnalyticsMeasurementId: null,
        themeColor: DEFAULT_THEME_COLOR,
        workspaceId: 'wsp_collection',
        faviconUrl: null,
        isStarterExtension: false,
        extensionScreen: ExtensionScreen.PORTAL_LOADED,
        result: {
            type: 'success',
            data: {
                extensionType: ExtensionType.PORTAL,
                extensionName: extension.name,
                extensionAccessToken: token,
                viewIdsToAirtableViews: {},
                publicFields,
                formRecord: {
                    type: 'edit',
                    recordId: 'rec00000000000001',
                    tableId,
                    data: {},
                },
                fieldNamesToSchemas,
                fieldIdsToSchemas: makeFieldIdsToSchemas(fieldNamesToSchemas),
                linkedRecordFieldIdToDetailFields: {
                    [fieldId]: [structuredClone(detail)],
                },
                linkedRecordFieldIdToFieldsTitles: {},
                cookieKeyForLoginToken: 'cookie_collection',
                fieldIdsInPortal: [fieldId],
                baseId: extension.baseId,
                loggedInUserCanEditExtension: false,
                showMiniExtensionsBranding: true,
                onFreePlan: false,
                trialExpiresAtUnixEpoch: null,
                usersTableFields: [structuredClone(linked)],
                initialLinkedTableStates: {},
                portalFieldIdToSearchPageField: {},
            },
        },
    };
}

function response(ids: string[], nextOffset: string | null = null): Response {
    return {
        recordIds: ids,
        airtableOffset: nextOffset,
        tableIdsToLinkedTableStates: {
            [tableId]: {
                airtableFields: [primary],
                recordIdsToAirtableRecords: Object.fromEntries(
                    ids.map((id) => [
                        id,
                        {
                            id,
                            fields: { [primary.id]: id },
                        },
                    ])
                ),
            },
        },
        customViewDetailFields: { [fieldId]: [detail] },
    };
}

function httpValue(data: unknown): Awaited<ReturnType<typeof axios>> {
    return {
        status: 200,
        statusText: 'OK',
        data,
        headers: {},
        config: { headers: {} },
    };
}
async function flush() {
    for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++)
        await act(async () => {
            await Promise.resolve();
        });
}

function harness() {
    const initial = createInitialPublicExtensionState();
    initial.sessionIdsToScreenStates[sessionId] = {
        type: 'loaded',
        data: screenFixture(),
    };
    initial.fieldIdsToPortalFieldsTabsStates[fieldId] = {
        sortFields: [],
        filters: null,
        searchTerm: 'query_A',
        selectedCell: null,
        monthInView: null,
        selectedCustomView: {
            id: 'view_A',
            label: 'Default',
            showRecordsNotLinkedToUser: false,
            hideEditButton: false,
            showBadge: false,
            visibleFieldIds: null,
            customViewLayout: 'grid',
            viewLayout: 'grid',
        },
    };
    const store = createTestStore(initial);
    const kernel = createNativePortalCollectionKernel<
        AirtableRecord,
        AirtableField,
        LinkedRecordDetailField,
        Response
    >();
    const native = () => store.getState().publicExtension;
    const scope = () => {
        const screen = native().sessionIdsToScreenStates[sessionId];
        if (
            screen?.type !== 'loaded' ||
            screen.data.extensionScreen !== ExtensionScreen.PORTAL_LOADED ||
            screen.data.result?.type !== 'success'
        ) {
            throw new Error('Expected loaded fixture');
        }
        return {
            sessionId,
            fieldId,
            linkedTableId: tableId,
            bindingKey: portalPresentationBinding(native(), sessionId, fieldId),
            fetchOwnerKey: JSON.stringify([
                sessionId,
                screen.data.result.data.extensionAccessToken,
            ]),
            // Host cache-owner epoch, deliberately independent of cache enrichment.
            cacheOwnerEpoch: 0,
        };
    };
    let sdk = kernel.createState(scope());
    type Receipt = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof kernel.begin>>['receipt'];
    type Pending = {
        receipt: Receipt | null;
        done: Promise<unknown>;
        resolve: ((value: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof axios>>) => void) | null;
    };
    const requests: {
        resolve: (value: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof axios>>) => void;
        body: unknown;
    }[] = [];
    http.mockImplementation(
        (config) =>
            new Promise((resolve) => {
                // Receipt must already be committed at the external I/O boundary.
                const owner = native().portalPresentationOwners?.[fieldId];
                const records = native().fieldIdsToPortalRecordStates[fieldId];
                expect(owner?.active).toBeTruthy();
                expect(records?.activeRequestId).toBe(owner?.active?.requestId);
                requests.push({
                    resolve,
                    body: typeof config === 'string' ? null : config.data,
                });
            })
    );
    const frame = () =>
        native().portalPresentationOwners?.[fieldId]?.frame ?? null;
    const observe = (idsOnly = false) => {
        const records = native().fieldIdsToPortalRecordStates[fieldId];
        const paging =
            records?.type === 'loaded'
                ? {
                      type: 'loaded' as const,
                      recordIds: records.data.recordIds,
                      nextOffset: records.data.airtableOffsetForNextPage,
                      isPaginating: Boolean(records.isPaginating),
                      isReloading: Boolean(records.isReloading),
                      ...(records.errorMessage === undefined
                          ? {}
                          : { errorMessage: records.errorMessage }),
                      ...(records.acceptedFetchOwner
                          ? {
                                acceptedFetchOwnerKey: JSON.stringify([
                                    records.acceptedFetchOwner
                                        .extensionSessionId,
                                    records.acceptedFetchOwner
                                        .extensionAccessToken,
                                ]),
                            }
                          : {}),
                  }
                : {
                      type: records?.type ?? 'notLoaded',
                      recordIds: [],
                      nextOffset: null,
                      isPaginating: false,
                      isReloading: false,
                      ...(records?.type === 'failed'
                          ? { errorMessage: records.errorMessage }
                          : {}),
                  };
        sdk = kernel.observe(
            sdk,
            scope(),
            idsOnly ? { idsOnly: true, paging } : {}
        );
    };
    const mutate = (
        action: Parameters<typeof store.dispatch>[0],
        idsOnly = false
    ) => {
        store.dispatch(action);
        observe(idsOnly);
    };
    const read = (
        mode: 'first' | 'next' | 'reload' = 'first',
        options: { cached?: boolean; retain?: boolean } = {}
    ): Pending => {
        observe();
        const before = requests.length;
        const done = store.dispatch(
            fetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortalThunk({
                extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                portalFieldId: fieldId,
                mode:
                    mode === 'first'
                        ? {
                              type: 'firstPage',
                              onlyFetchIfNotAlreadyFetched:
                                  options.cached ?? false,
                          }
                        : mode === 'next'
                          ? {
                                type: 'nextPage',
                                ...(options.retain
                                    ? {
                                          retainLoadedRecordsOnFailure:
                                              true as const,
                                      }
                                    : {}),
                            }
                          : { type: 'reload' },
            })
        );
        const admission = native().portalPresentationOwners?.[fieldId]?.active;
        const actual = requests.length === before ? null : requests[before]!;
        const next = kernel.begin(sdk, {
            requestId:
                actual && admission
                    ? admission.requestId
                    : `rejected_${before}`,
            mode,
            onlyIfNotFetched: options.cached ?? false,
            retainNextOnFailure: options.retain ?? false,
        });
        expect(next != null).toBe(actual != null);
        if (next) sdk = next.state;
        return {
            receipt: next?.receipt ?? null,
            done,
            resolve: actual?.resolve ?? null,
        };
    };
    function qualified(data: Response) {
        const table = data.tableIdsToLinkedTableStates[tableId];
        const fields = data.customViewDetailFields?.[fieldId];
        const schemas = table?.airtableFields ?? [];
        const primaries = schemas.filter((field) => field.isPrimaryField);
        const primarySchema = primaries.length === 1 ? primaries[0]! : null;
        const overrides =
            fields?.filter((field) => field.fieldId === primarySchema?.id) ??
            [];
        return {
            linkedTableId: tableId,
            recordIds: data.recordIds,
            recordsById: table?.recordIdsToAirtableRecords ?? {},
            schema: table ? schemas : null,
            details: {
                presence:
                    data.customViewDetailFields == null
                        ? ('null' as const)
                        : fields === undefined
                          ? ('missing' as const)
                          : ('present' as const),
                fields: fields ?? [],
            },
            primary:
                !primarySchema || overrides.length > 1
                    ? null
                    : (overrides[0] ?? {
                          fieldId: primarySchema.id,
                          fieldName: primarySchema.name,
                          titleOverride: null,
                          isHidden: false,
                          miniExtConfig: {},
                          fieldIsInEditingChildForm: false,
                          childFormField: null,
                      }),
            nextOffset: data.airtableOffset,
            projection: data,
            scopeAfter: scope(),
        };
    }
    const success = async (pending: Pending, data: Response) => {
        if (!pending.resolve || !pending.receipt)
            throw new Error('Expected admitted read');
        // Equal response bytes, distinct transport object: native Immer may freeze
        // its response while SDK input-mutation assertions retain a mutable input.
        pending.resolve(httpValue(structuredClone(data)));
        await pending.done;
        const result = kernel.succeed(sdk, pending.receipt, qualified(data));
        if (result) sdk = result.state;
        return result;
    };
    const failure = async (
        pending: Pending,
        message = 'Selected view unavailable'
    ) => {
        if (!pending.resolve || !pending.receipt)
            throw new Error('Expected admitted read');
        pending.resolve(httpValue({ error: true, message }));
        await pending.done;
        const result = kernel.fail(sdk, pending.receipt, message);
        if (result) sdk = result.state;
        return result;
    };
    const equal = () => {
        const actual = native().fieldIdsToPortalRecordStates[fieldId];
        expect(sdk.paging.type).toBe(actual?.type ?? 'notLoaded');
        if (actual?.type === 'loaded') {
            expect(sdk.paging.recordIds).toEqual(actual.data.recordIds);
            expect(sdk.paging.nextOffset).toBe(
                actual.data.airtableOffsetForNextPage
            );
            expect(Boolean(sdk.paging.isPaginating)).toBe(
                Boolean(actual.isPaginating)
            );
            expect(Boolean(sdk.paging.isReloading)).toBe(
                Boolean(actual.isReloading)
            );
        }
        if (actual?.type === 'failed' || actual?.type === 'loaded')
            expect(sdk.paging.errorMessage).toBe(actual.errorMessage);
        const accepted = frame();
        expect(
            sdk.frame && {
                id: sdk.frame.id,
                recordIds: sdk.frame.recordIds,
                records: sdk.frame.records,
                schema: sdk.frame.schema,
                details: sdk.frame.details,
                primary: sdk.frame.primary,
                nextOffset: sdk.frame.nextOffset,
            }
        ).toEqual(
            accepted && {
                id: accepted.frameId,
                recordIds: accepted.recordIds,
                records: accepted.records,
                schema: accepted.schema,
                details: accepted.details,
                primary: accepted.primary,
                nextOffset: accepted.nextOffset,
            }
        );
    };
    const load = async (data = response(['rec00000000000001'], 'cursor_B')) => {
        await success(read(), data);
        equal();
    };
    return {
        store,
        native,
        kernel,
        scope,
        read,
        success,
        failure,
        equal,
        load,
        mutate,
        observe,
        requests,
        frame,
        qualified,
        sdk: () => sdk,
        setSdk: (next: typeof sdk) => {
            sdk = next;
        },
    };
}

describe('prepared actual-native canonical collection differential A-H', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
        http.mockReset();
        window.history.replaceState({}, '', '/portal');
        localStorage.clear();
    });
    afterEach(() => {
        jest.useRealTimers();
    });

    it.each([true, false])(
        'A: forced replacement wins, old success first=%s; duplicate cached intent sends nothing',
        async (oldFirst) => {
            const h = harness();
            await h.load();
            const old = h.read('reload');
            const current = h.read();
            const duplicate = h.read('first', { cached: true });
            await duplicate.done;
            expect(duplicate.receipt).toBeNull();
            expect(h.requests).toHaveLength(3);
            if (oldFirst) {
                expect(await h.success(old, response(['rec_old']))).toBeNull();
                h.equal();
            }
            await h.success(current, response(['rec_current']));
            h.equal();
            if (!oldFirst) {
                expect(await h.success(old, response(['rec_old']))).toBeNull();
                h.equal();
            }
            expect(h.sdk().frame?.recordIds).toEqual(['rec_current']);
        }
    );

    it('B: Next and reload retain rows while pending; ordinary failure has the native failed state', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        await h.load();
        const presentation = createNativePortalPresentation(h.store, {
            extensionSessionId: sessionId,
            portalFieldId: fieldId,
        });
        expect(presentation.getChild()?.extensionId).toBe(
            'ext_collection_child'
        );
        const next = h.read('next');
        h.equal();
        expect(presentation.getChild()?.frameId).toBe(h.sdk().frame?.id);
        expect(h.sdk().paging.recordIds).toEqual(['rec00000000000001']);
        expect(h.sdk().paging.isPaginating).toBe(true);
        await h.success(next, response(['rec_B'], 'cursor_C'));
        h.equal();
        const reload = h.read('reload');
        h.equal();
        expect(presentation.getChild()?.frameId).toBe(h.sdk().frame?.id);
        expect(h.sdk().paging.isReloading).toBe(true);
        await h.failure(reload);
        h.equal();
        expect(h.sdk().paging.type).toBe('failed');
        expect(presentation.getChild()).toBeNull();
        await h.success(
            h.read('first', { cached: true }),
            response(['rec_recovered'])
        );
        h.equal();
        expect(presentation.getChild()?.extensionId).toBe(
            'ext_collection_child'
        );
        presentation.destroy();
    });

    it('B: explicit retained Next failure preserves exact cursor and admitted retry', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        await h.load();
        const presentation = createNativePortalPresentation(h.store, {
            extensionSessionId: sessionId,
            portalFieldId: fieldId,
        });
        const accepted = h.sdk().frame;
        await h.failure(h.read('next', { retain: true }), 'Page unavailable');
        h.equal();
        expect(h.sdk().frame).toBe(accepted);
        expect(h.sdk().paging.nextOffset).toBe('cursor_B');
        expect(h.sdk().paging.errorMessage).toBe('Page unavailable');
        expect(presentation.getChild()?.frameId).toBe(accepted?.id);
        const retry = h.read('next', { retain: true });
        expect(h.requests.at(-1)?.body).toMatchObject({
            airtableOffset: 'cursor_B',
        });
        await h.success(retry, response(['rec_B']));
        h.equal();
        presentation.destroy();
    });

    it.each(['query', 'token', 'schema'] as const)(
        'C: observed %s A-B-A retires an old failure',
        async (kind) => {
            const h = harness();
            await h.load();
            const old = h.read('reload');
            if (kind === 'query') {
                for (const searchTerm of ['query_B', 'query_A'])
                    h.mutate(
                        publicExtensionActions.updateSearchTermForPortalField({
                            fieldId,
                            searchTerm,
                        })
                    );
            } else {
                for (const changed of [true, false]) {
                    const screen = screenFixture(
                        changed && kind === 'token' ? 'token_B' : 'token_A'
                    );
                    if (
                        kind === 'schema' &&
                        changed &&
                        screen.result?.type === 'success'
                    )
                        screen.result.data.fieldIdsToSchemas[
                            fieldId
                        ]!.airtableField.name = 'Changed';
                    h.mutate(
                        publicExtensionActions.setLoadedScreenStateForSession({
                            extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                            screenState: screen,
                        })
                    );
                }
            }
            const before = h.native();
            expect(await h.failure(old)).toBeNull();
            expect(h.native()).toBe(before);
            expect(h.sdk().frame).toBeNull();
            h.equal();
            await h.success(
                h.read('first', { cached: true }),
                response(['rec_current'])
            );
            h.equal();
        }
    );

    it('C/D: benign cache enrichment cannot retire a read or fill withheld response values', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        await h.load();
        const pending = h.read('reload');
        h.mutate(
            publicExtensionActions.addMoreTableIdsToLinkedTableStates({
                tableIdsToLinkedTableStates: response(['rec_decoy'])
                    .tableIdsToLinkedTableStates,
            })
        );
        expect(h.kernel.isCurrent(h.sdk(), pending.receipt!)).toBe(true);
        const fresh = response(['rec00000000000001']);
        fresh.tableIdsToLinkedTableStates[
            tableId
        ]!.recordIdsToAirtableRecords.rec00000000000001!.fields = {};
        await h.success(pending, fresh);
        h.equal();
        expect(h.sdk().frame?.records[0]?.fields).toEqual({});
    });

    it.each([
        'missing-row',
        'missing-details',
        'null-details',
        'empty-details',
    ] as const)(
        'D: response-only provenance %s preserves separate legacy and frame projections',
        async (kind) => {
            const h = harness();
            await h.load();
            const incoming = response([
                'rec00000000000001',
                'rec00000000000001',
            ]);
            if (kind === 'missing-row')
                incoming.tableIdsToLinkedTableStates[
                    tableId
                ]!.recordIdsToAirtableRecords = {};
            if (kind === 'missing-details')
                incoming.customViewDetailFields = {};
            if (kind === 'null-details') incoming.customViewDetailFields = null;
            if (kind === 'empty-details')
                incoming.customViewDetailFields = { [fieldId]: [] };
            const result = await h.success(h.read(), incoming);
            h.equal();
            expect(result?.compatibility?.recordIds).toEqual(
                incoming.recordIds
            );
            if (kind === 'missing-row') expect(h.sdk().frame).toBeNull();
            else {
                expect(h.sdk().frame?.recordIds).toEqual(['rec00000000000001']);
                expect(h.sdk().frame?.details.presence).toBe(
                    kind === 'missing-details'
                        ? 'missing'
                        : kind === 'null-details'
                          ? 'null'
                          : 'present'
                );
            }
        }
    );

    it('E: null cursor sends nothing, empty cursor is admitted, parent replacement retires pending append', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        await h.load(response(['rec_A'], ''));
        const append = h.read('next');
        expect(h.requests.at(-1)?.body).toMatchObject({ airtableOffset: '' });
        await h.success(h.read('reload'), response(['rec_replaced']));
        h.equal();
        const before = h.native();
        expect(await h.success(append, response(['rec_stale']))).toBeNull();
        expect(h.native()).toBe(before);
        h.equal();
        const exhausted = h.read('next');
        await exhausted.done;
        expect(exhausted.receipt).toBeNull();
    });

    it.each(['replace', 'append', 'clear'] as const)(
        'E: IDs-only %s publication retires accepted and pending frame',
        async (kind) => {
            const h = harness();
            await h.load();
            const pending = h.read('next');
            const payload = {
                fieldId,
                portalRecordsState: {
                    recordIds: ['rec_ids_only'],
                    airtableOffsetForNextPage: null,
                },
            };
            h.mutate(
                kind === 'replace'
                    ? publicExtensionActions.replacePortalRecordsStateForField(
                          payload
                      )
                    : kind === 'append'
                      ? publicExtensionActions.appendPortalRecordsStateForField(
                            payload
                        )
                      : publicExtensionActions.clearPortalViewStateForField({
                            extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                            fieldId,
                        }),
                true
            );
            expect(h.sdk().frame).toBeNull();
            h.equal();
            const before = h.native();
            expect(
                await h.success(pending, response(['rec_stale']))
            ).toBeNull();
            expect(h.native()).toBe(before);
        }
    );

    it.each(['add', 'remove'] as const)(
        'E REQUIRED CUTOVER FAILURE: direct post-action %s retires frame and pending read',
        async (kind) => {
            const h = harness();
            await h.load();
            const pending = h.read('next');
            h.mutate(
                kind === 'add'
                    ? publicExtensionActions.addRecordIdToLinkedRecordsCellForForm(
                          {
                              extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                              fieldId,
                              newRecordIdToAdd: 'rec_added',
                              doNotUpdateHasUnsavedChange: true,
                          }
                      )
                    : publicExtensionActions.removeRecordIdFromLinkedRecordsCellForExtension(
                          {
                              extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                              fieldId,
                              recordIdToRemove: 'rec00000000000001',
                              doNotUpdateHasUnsavedChange: true,
                          }
                      ),
                true
            );
            expect(h.sdk().frame).toBeNull();
            // The old wrapper only recognizes replace/append/clear action names.
            expect(h.frame()).toBeNull();
            const before = h.native();
            expect(
                await h.success(pending, response(['rec_stale']))
            ).toBeNull();
            expect(h.native()).toBe(before);
        }
    );

    it('F REQUIRED CUTOVER FAILURE: direct ordinary stale failure cannot overwrite a successor', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        await h.load();
        const old = h.read('reload');
        await h.success(h.read(), response(['rec_current']));
        expect(
            h.kernel.fail(h.sdk(), old.receipt!, 'Stale failure')
        ).toBeNull();
        const before = h.native();
        // The cutover owner must extend this real action with its exact receipt.
        // Existing unscoped ordinary failure is not an authority grant.
        h.store.dispatch(
            publicExtensionActions.failedToLoadRecordIdsForPortalField({
                fieldId,
                errorMessage: 'Stale failure',
            })
        );
        expect(h.native()).toBe(before);
    });

    it('F: native subscribers observe one coherent success publication and immutable response snapshots', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        await h.load();
        const seen: string[][] = [];
        const stop = h.store.subscribe(() => {
            const frame = h.frame();
            if (!frame) return;
            const records = h.native().fieldIdsToPortalRecordStates[fieldId];
            expect(records?.type).toBe('loaded');
            if (records?.type !== 'loaded')
                throw new Error('Frame without legacy IDs');
            expect(frame.recordIds).toEqual([
                ...new Set(records.data.recordIds),
            ]);
            const cache = h.native().tableIdsToLinkedTableStates[tableId];
            expect(cache?.type).toBe('loaded');
            expect(frame.primary?.titleOverride).toBe('');
            expect(frame.primary?.isHidden).toBe(true);
            seen.push(frame.recordIds);
        });
        const incoming = response(['rec_B', 'rec_A']);
        await h.success(h.read(), incoming);
        stop();
        h.equal();
        incoming.recordIds.push('rec_mutated');
        incoming.tableIdsToLinkedTableStates[
            tableId
        ]!.recordIdsToAirtableRecords.rec_B!.fields[primary.id] = 'mutated';
        expect(h.sdk().frame?.recordIds).toEqual(['rec_B', 'rec_A']);
        expect(h.sdk().frame?.records[0]?.fields[primary.id]).toBe('rec_B');
        expect(seen).toContainEqual(['rec_B', 'rec_A']);
    });

    it('F REQUIRED CUTOVER FAILURE: a superseded reentrant begin sends no retired transport', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        let entered = false;
        const stop = h.store.subscribe(() => {
            if (
                entered ||
                !h.native().portalPresentationOwners?.[fieldId]?.active
            )
                return;
            entered = true;
            void h.store.dispatch(
                fetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortalThunk({
                    extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                    portalFieldId: fieldId,
                    mode: {
                        type: 'firstPage',
                        onlyFetchIfNotAlreadyFetched: false,
                    },
                })
            );
        });
        void h.store.dispatch(
            fetchRecordsForLinkedTableOnPortalThunk({
                extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                portalFieldId: fieldId,
                mode: {
                    type: 'firstPage',
                    onlyFetchIfNotAlreadyFetched: false,
                },
            })
        );
        stop();
        // Old native source sends two. Preserve this assertion until atomic cutover.
        expect(h.requests).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it('G: current cleanup corrects criteria before automatic forced First; sort has precedence', async () => {
        jest.useFakeTimers();
        const notices = renderHook(() => useToast());
        act(() => notices.result.current.dismiss());
        const h = harness();
        const pending = h.read();
        const cleaned: Response = {
            recordIds: [],
            airtableOffset: null,
            tableIdsToLinkedTableStates: {},
            customViewDetailFields: null,
        };
        cleaned.endUserSortCleanup = { sortFields: [] };
        cleaned.endUserFilterCleanup = { filters: null };
        pending.resolve!(httpValue(cleaned));
        await flush();
        const transition = h.kernel.cleanup(
            h.sdk(),
            pending.receipt!,
            'sort',
            [],
            h.scope()
        );
        expect(transition?.cleanup?.kind).toBe('sort');
        if (!transition?.cleanup) throw new Error('Expected current cleanup');
        h.setSdk(transition.state);
        expect(h.frame()).toBeNull();
        expect(
            h.native().fieldIdsToPortalFieldsTabsStates[fieldId]?.sortFields
        ).toEqual([]);
        const continuation = h.kernel.completeCleanup(
            h.sdk(),
            transition.cleanup.receipt
        );
        expect(continuation?.read).toEqual({
            mode: 'first',
            onlyIfNotFetched: false,
        });
        expect(h.requests).toHaveLength(2);
        const active = h.native().portalPresentationOwners?.[fieldId]?.active;
        if (!active || !continuation)
            throw new Error('Expected automatic First');
        h.setSdk(continuation.state);
        const begin = h.kernel.begin(h.sdk(), {
            requestId: active.requestId,
            mode: 'first',
            onlyIfNotFetched: false,
        });
        if (!begin) throw new Error('Expected kernel First');
        h.setSdk(begin.state);
        const fresh = response(['rec_current']);
        h.requests[1]!.resolve(httpValue(fresh));
        await pending.done;
        const settled = h.kernel.succeed(
            h.sdk(),
            begin.receipt,
            h.qualified(fresh)
        );
        if (!settled) throw new Error('Expected cleanup follow-up settlement');
        h.setSdk(settled.state);
        h.equal();
        act(() => {
            jest.advanceTimersByTime(0);
        });
        expect(
            notices.result.current.toasts.some(
                (toast) => toast.open && toast.description != null
            )
        ).toBe(true);
        act(() => notices.result.current.dismiss());
        notices.unmount();
    });

    it('G: stale cleanup has no correction, notice, or follow-up read', async () => {
        jest.useFakeTimers();
        const notices = renderHook(() => useToast());
        act(() => notices.result.current.dismiss());
        const h = harness();
        const old = h.read();
        const newest = h.read();
        const cleanup: Response = {
            recordIds: [],
            airtableOffset: null,
            tableIdsToLinkedTableStates: {},
            customViewDetailFields: null,
        };
        cleanup.endUserSortCleanup = { sortFields: [] };
        const before = h.native();
        old.resolve!(httpValue(cleanup));
        await old.done;
        expect(h.kernel.cleanup(h.sdk(), old.receipt!, 'sort', [])).toBeNull();
        expect(h.native()).toBe(before);
        expect(h.requests).toHaveLength(2);
        act(() => {
            jest.advanceTimersByTime(0);
        });
        expect(
            notices.result.current.toasts.every((toast) => !toast.open)
        ).toBe(true);
        await h.success(newest, response(['rec_current']));
        h.equal();
        notices.unmount();
    });

    it('G REQUIRED CUTOVER FAILURE: cleanup correction reentrancy retires notice and automatic First', async () => {
        jest.useFakeTimers();
        const notices = renderHook(() => useToast());
        act(() => notices.result.current.dismiss());
        const h = harness();
        const pending = h.read();
        const safeSort = [
            {
                idOrName: { type: 'id' as const, id: primary.id },
                type: 'asc' as const,
            },
        ];
        const correction =
            publicExtensionActions.updateFieldIdsToPortalSortFields({
                fieldId,
                sortFields: safeSort,
            });
        const correctedScope = {
            ...h.scope(),
            bindingKey: portalPresentationBinding(
                publicExtensionReducer(h.native(), correction),
                sessionId,
                fieldId
            ),
        };
        let reentered = false;
        const stop = h.store.subscribe(() => {
            if (
                reentered ||
                h.native().fieldIdsToPortalFieldsTabsStates[fieldId]?.sortFields
                    .length !== 1
            )
                return;
            reentered = true;
            h.store.dispatch(
                publicExtensionActions.updateSearchTermForPortalField({
                    fieldId,
                    searchTerm: 'query_after_cleanup',
                })
            );
        });
        pending.resolve!(
            httpValue({
                recordIds: [],
                airtableOffset: null,
                tableIdsToLinkedTableStates: {},
                customViewDetailFields: null,
                endUserSortCleanup: { sortFields: safeSort },
            } satisfies Response)
        );
        await flush();
        stop();
        const cleanup = h.kernel.cleanup(
            h.sdk(),
            pending.receipt!,
            'sort',
            safeSort,
            correctedScope
        );
        if (!cleanup?.cleanup)
            throw new Error('Expected SDK correction receipt');
        h.setSdk(h.kernel.observe(cleanup.state, h.scope()));
        expect(
            h.kernel.completeCleanup(h.sdk(), cleanup.cleanup.receipt)
        ).toBeNull();
        // Current source still schedules a notice and issues the forced read.
        expect(h.requests).toHaveLength(1);
        act(() => {
            jest.advanceTimersByTime(0);
        });
        expect(
            notices.result.current.toasts.every((toast) => !toast.open)
        ).toBe(true);
        notices.unmount();
    });

    it('H: UI projection destroy/remount does not dispose a canonical pending read', async () => {
        const h = harness();
        await h.load();
        const pending = h.read('reload');
        const projection = createNativePortalPresentation(h.store, {
            extensionSessionId: sessionId,
            portalFieldId: fieldId,
        });
        projection.destroy();
        expect(h.kernel.isCurrent(h.sdk(), pending.receipt!)).toBe(true);
        await h.success(pending, response(['rec_after_remount']));
        h.equal();
        const remount = createNativePortalPresentation(h.store, {
            extensionSessionId: sessionId,
            portalFieldId: fieldId,
        });
        expect(
            remount.scope.getSnapshot().rows.map((row) => row.recordId)
        ).toEqual(['rec_after_remount']);
        remount.destroy();
        const retired = h.read('reload');
        h.setSdk(h.kernel.retire(h.sdk()));
        expect(h.kernel.isCurrent(h.sdk(), retired.receipt!)).toBe(false);
        // Host lifetime retirement is a host action, never inferred from projection unmount.
        h.store.dispatch(
            publicExtensionActions.clearPortalViewStateForField({
                extensionSessionId: sessionId,
                fieldId,
            })
        );
        const before = h.native();
        expect(await h.success(retired, response(['rec_stale']))).toBeNull();
        expect(h.native()).toBe(before);
    });
});
